title: Redemption Grace Period Restores (Domain Registrations)
content:
## Registry operations rule — restores out of the Redemption Grace Period (Domain Registrations)

**Rule 1 — status.** A restore may be charged only while the domain status is redemption.

**Rule 2 — window.** A restore is allowed only on or before the date the domain entered redemption plus the TLD's redemption days, counted in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the redemption date, counting the day after it as day 1, and the last day is included.

**Rule 3 — billing (no longer in force).** The clause "A restore is billed as the restore fee plus the TLD's included renewal years at the renewal price plus the ICANN fee for each of those years, and the new expiry date is the original expiry date plus those years" is no longer in force — superseded by the current basis for redemption restores of Domain Registrations.

**Rule 4 — availability.** Restore is offered only where the TLD's restore availability is Yes. Once the domain reaches pending delete it cannot be restored or renewed by anyone, and the name is released after the TLD's pending delete days.

**Rule 5 — refunds (no longer in force).** The clause "A restore charge is never refundable" is no longer in force — superseded by the current basis.

**Rule 6 — discounts.** No account-tier or bulk discount applies to any part of a restore charge.

### Reading the window of Rule 2

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | the date the domain entered redemption, as recorded on the domain |
| Day 1 | the day after the redemption date |
| Length | the TLD's redemption days, whole calendar days |
| Comparison | the restore day is not later than the last day |
| Last day | included |

Boundary cases: a restore on the redemption date plus the TLD's redemption days is allowed; a restore on the following day is not. Hypothetical: a domain that entered redemption on 6 February 2029 under a 30-day window has 8 March 2029 as its last day (2029 is not a leap year); 8 March is inside, 9 March is outside.

### Basis

The redemption status and the redemption date are read from the system record of the domain being restored. Tier figures (restore fee, renewal price, redemption days) are those of the domain's own TLD product.
